verdict.rationale: Dagster models each table or connector as an individual asset, so a single asset can be updated on its own. The docs explicitly say you can use the UI or APIs to run subsets of dbt models. Fivetran, Airbyte and dlt connectors appear as assets that can be triggered individually, and the changelog mentions partitioned assets, which implies partition-level history handling. However, nothing in the pack explicitly documents backfills. Missing for 10: explicit backfill/partition-range rerun documentation, a documented single-table resync for ingestion connectors, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
